findings.claim: Route 53 DNS telemetry for brewertalk.com in `aws:cloudwatchlogs` `source="lambda:DNS"` produced an average distinct third-level subdomain length of 6.80.
Osquery shell-history evidence on hoth showed root editing `/etc/tomcat8/tomcat-users.xml`, making it the strongest identified privilege-escalation artifact for tomcat8.
Taedonggang-related investigation narrowed the likely artifact trail to brewertalk thread `tid=21` with attachment thumbnail IDs `2,3,4,5,6,7,8`.

Retrieved attachment thumbnails on thread `tid=21` were observed from `20/Aug/2018:13:08:57 +0000` through `20/Aug/2018:13:47:19 +0000`; thumbnails 2-7 were `image/jpeg` and thumbnail 8 was `image/png` (15801 bytes).
